about_the_game:
Fly through a high rise city as a bird while racing against your friends (even enemies are an option) or just the clock for the fastest time.

You might even win a crown.

Key features

  • Birb customization

    • You can choose a hat your bird will wear while flying

  • Online or LAN multiplayer

  • Simple 3 button controls

    • Easy to understand, but hard to master

  • In-game clock

short_description: Birb Game is a multiplayer first racing game with unique perspective of being a bird. Customize your bird with the selection of hats and race against your friends in online multiplayer, or just fly alone and try to beat your best time.
